about: Play parameters of our engine (wave2 engine in hybrid mode on twin-s-clock it13) for cluster/tune_round.py. 'where': 'player' is a player option of the arena's wave2 team (arena/players/upstream.py: CONTROLLER_KW, WAVE2_CONTROLLER_KW, WAVE2_FLAGS), 'engine' a raw UCI option sent through engine_options after the flags (third_party/wave2-hivemind/engine/src/interface/uci.cc). 'value' is today's setting (the hybrid of runs/wave2c/r4/long/l_hybrid_120). 'speed': true marks options that change the wall time a searched node costs (mate provers, threads); see docs/tuning.md before tuning them. 'prior' is a rough guess of how much the knob can matter (high, medium, low), used only to order the recommended first round. Read docs/tuning.md.
model: twin-s-clock it13 (HF aminwoo/bughouse-twin-s-clock@edaa246, sha256 f4ac25e3...), the pool's default wave2 model

charge.source: warm ms/node on the PACE RTX 6000 (job 16047669, docs/speed_gap.md): hybrid 0.0431-0.0433, upstream v3.0.3 0.0428-0.0435 on it13. The r4 long test's cold per-part values (ours 0.050-0.054, upstream 0.042-0.053) charged the first-measured arm ~20% too much; the final match is to run with MEASURE_WARM_MS=3000 MEASURE_REPEATS=10, which should read ~0.043 for both.

params.name: clock_k
params.why: time management: each search gets clock / clock_k / ms_per_node nodes (one step = x1.41). Upstream-it13 keeps 110. 75% of the clock is never used and clock lead goes with winning (docs/elo_hunt_analysis.md lever 1): sweep it first, wide (grid 55, 220, 440, 1000).

params.name: root_lag_ms
params.why: added to RootMoveTimeMs: what the tree thinks one of our actions costs on the clock (v3 rules: landing lag 0..150 ms, mean 75).

params.name: root_min_ms
params.why: floor of RootMoveTimeMs (v3 min_move_ms 100).

params.name: ema_alpha
params.why: smoothing of the per-team and per-seat move-time EMAs sent as TeamMoveTimeMs/OpponentMoveTimeMs/SeatPaceMs.

params.name: min_nodes
params.why: floor of the node budget: matters only in time scrambles (at clock_k 110 and 0.0525 ms a node, 116 nodes is the budget at 0.67 s left, 816 at 4.7 s).

params.name: pass_cap_k
params.why: PassCapK: a pass lasts until the next event on the other board, capped at k x RootMoveTimeMs; also caps the arena's sit wait.

params.name: hybrid_margin_permille
params.why: HybridMarginPermille: how much better the root sit must look than the best move before the hybrid keeps it (spec v6).

params.name: hybrid_pass_prior_permille
params.why: HybridPassPriorPermille: prior floor given to the root sit when the trigger fires (300 with margin 0 scored 0.456 vs nodur locally).

params.name: hybrid_max_wait_ms
params.why: HybridMaxWaitMs: longest expected wait for the other board's event that still triggers a sit.

params.name: hybrid_min_clock_ms
params.why: HybridMinClockMs: no hybrid sit with less than this on our clock.

params.name: hybrid_event_lands
params.why: HybridEventLands: which events the hybrid's sit branch lets land.

params.name: CPUCTInitPermille
params.why: PUCT exploration constant (CPUCT_INIT 3.0, CrazyAra 2.5); set by upstream at 100 ms per move, never at ~20k nodes per search.

params.name: PolicyTemperaturePermille
params.why: softmax temperature of the search priors; calibrated to 800-node visits, its Elo value never measured.

params.name: MovesLeftDiscountPermille
params.why: value discount per 100 plies left; search_params.h: 'strength-affecting and unvalidated: sweep it in a paired tournament'.

params.name: PWCoefficientPermille
params.why: progressive widening below the root: children = ceil(coef x visits^exp) (floor under PUCT widening).

params.name: RootPWCoefficientPermille
params.why: progressive widening coefficient at the root.

params.name: PWExponentPermille
params.why: progressive widening exponent.

params.name: PUCTWidening
params.why: PUCT widening on top of the count floor (+28 +-15 Elo at 100 ms upstream).

params.name: GumbelRootSearch
params.why: Gumbel root search (off upstream).

params.name: Transpositions
params.why: MCGS transposition table; changes node cost.

params.name: MateProbe
params.why: root mate prover (wall-time slices on CPU).

params.name: FrozenRace
params.why: frozen-race mate check (wall-time slices on CPU).

params.name: ConditionalMateProbe
params.why: root conditional mate prover.

params.name: CertifySelectedMove
params.why: certify the selected move against mate before playing it (wall time).

params.name: InternalMateProbe
params.why: in-tree mate probe mode (telemetry is a no-op for play and left out).

params.name: MateThreads
params.why: CPU threads of the mate provers (the eval job has 6 CPUs for 3 games of 2 engines).

fixed.BatchSize: 8: compiled into the TensorRT engine; another size builds a new engine for minutes at the first setoption (cluster/warm_engine.py warms only the default), past the arena's 120 s start-up timeout. Tune it in a bench, not here.
fixed.search threads: HIVEMIND_SEARCH_WORKERS (4) is a configure-time define of the build, not a UCI option.
fixed.CPUCT_BASE, FPU_REDUCTION, Q_VETO_DELTA,: compile-time constants in search_params.h with no UCI option: tuning them needs an engine change.
fixed.max_nodes: 100000 is never reached at 120 s (budget ~20k nodes at 110 / 0.0525).
fixed.DrawContemptPermille: draws are ~0.5% of games at 120 s; nothing to gain.
